items.title: TikTok - Videos, Shop & LIVE
items.subtitle: Watch, discover and stream!
items.editorialDescription: If you ever see a group of teenagers (or twenty- or thirtysomethings) filming themselves doing literally anything, know this: They’re probably making a video to share on TikTok. Its infinite scroll of new videos combines perfectly edited lip-synching, hilarious sketches, and mesmerizing dance moves with delightful special effects and filters. It’s hard not to fall in love with everyone’s fluffy pets, awkward parents, impressive glow-ups, fails of every kind, and songs and pop-culture references that spark a million memes.
items.shortEditorialDescription: Make awesome short music videos that you can share with the world.

items.title: Procreate Pocket
items.subtitle: Sketch and Paint on iPhone.
items.editorialDescription: Inspiration tends to strike when you least expect it—heck, some of our best ideas come to us in the shower—and Procreate is a dazzling way to snatch sparks of visual genius out of the ether and bring them to life. Behind the app’s slick drawing and painting tools are robust features that you’d expect from a full-fledged illustration package—it even has the ingenious ability to use your Apple Watch as a color palette picker. If a brilliant notion does strike in the shower, though, get out and dry off.
items.shortEditorialDescription: This super-intuitive app makes it easy to paint your masterpiece.

items.title: Streaks
items.subtitle: Habit Tracker & To-Do List
items.editorialDescription: It’s not every day that an app helps you become a better person. But that’s what Streaks does with a simple, compelling design that gets out of the way—and lets you focus on healthy eating, reading, flossing, and winning at life. Oh yeah, and it’s one of the best Apple Watch apps we’ve ever used.
items.shortEditorialDescription: "Remind me to Walk the Dog in 15 minutes in Streaks."
